sources.title: Advancing deep learning based knee cartilage segmentation in MRI ...
sources.snippet: The study highlights substantial improvements against conventional methods in segmentation accuracy and efficiency using DL-based methods, given challenging scenarios of knee MRI. Solutions to key challenges are presented, and clinical applications showcase the potential of automated segmentation for cartilage thickness mapping and OA assessment.
